title: Public dense integer selectors
objective: Route public dense ZZ row and column selection through generated bulk FmpzMatrix selectors with Sage-compatible semantics, focused regressions, and a tight performance ratchet

handoff.summary: Public dense ZZ row and column selection now normalizes and packs indices once, then returns the result of one generated FmpzMatrix selector call. Focused tests cover resource-only huge/skew matrices, duplicates, negative and invalid indices, empty shapes, source immutability, native-required and native-disabled N-API-forbidden execution, and generated-resource traces. The 500x500 public performance ratchet selects 250 rows or columns in about 1.8-2.1 ms raw with a 3 ms normalized ceiling, replacing the former 12-21 ms incremental resource route.
next_steps: Integrate this branch after the generated FmpzMatrix selector declarations already present on dense-qq-resources.
